[LGRA.12.4.1] **What a `.` separates depends on where it stands.** In
expression position it is a slot-access / `Json`-path chain (`p.entity_id`,
`response.forecast[0].max`) or a library member (`math.pi`), resolved by scope
([LGRA.22.9]). Inside a library path (`import units.si`) or a service's own name
(the `light.turn_on` in `call light.turn_on`) it is an internal segment separator.
In a pattern head it separates a library path from a schema ([LGRA.22.4]).
